description: The Ironfang Brute is a towering, muscular figure with skin as tough as iron. Its tusk-like teeth protrude from a snarling maw, and its eyes glow with a malevolent intelligence. It wields a massive spiked club, bashing foes with brutal strength.
damage_resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Brutal Assault
traits.description: The Ironfang Brute deals an extra 1d6 damage on melee attacks when it hits with a melee weapon.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: Once per day, when the Brute is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, it can drop to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Ironfang Brute makes two attacks with its spiked club.

actions.name: Spiked Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage.
